The Marina - Project Organizer - Capability Sharing - (in development)

The Marina is a Trust and Interoperability platform into which you "dock" your projects. Process Based Methodology (my book) and scale-proven Technology Rules have led to a method to "conform" your projects so they expose/encapsulate capabilities.

  • Git Project OrganizerWorkflow, Tagging, Namespaces for Git Projects.
  • Git Project SecuritySecurity Guardrails enable you to trust projects by other developers.
  • Project Capabilities CatalogShare Services, Data, Servers, Resources.
  • Agents enforce standardsBest practices/Branding across your projects.
  • Conformed DocumentationConsistent documentation across your projects.
  • Enterprise Command CenterLogging, Monitoring & Alerting, Scheduling, Pipelines.
  • Cloud Service LayerExposes cloud services as shared project capabilities
  • Built By Drydock to test the implementation of a large project
